alt.en: The assigned training estimate has 16 MB of model state and 1,310,720 activation bytes. Sharding the optimizer-related state changes the first term; saving fewer activations changes the second. Recovery separately needs a consistent snapshot, sampler state, step and versions.
alt.zh-hans: 给定训练估算包含 16 MB 模型状态和 1,310,720 字节激活。优化器相关状态分片改变前一项，减少保存的激活改变后一项。恢复运行还需要一致的快照、采样器状态、步数和版本。

flow.en: Optimizer-only sharding reduces this storage from 16 MB to 7 MB per worker. Gradients are reset at update boundaries.
flow.zh-hans: 仅分片优化器相关状态，每个进程的这部分存储从 16 MB 降至 7 MB；梯度在更新边界重置。

保留 16 个数组，其余重算

flow.en: Recomputation saves activation storage and adds forward work.
flow.zh-hans: 重算减少激活存储，增加前向计算。

text.zh-hans: 一致的权重与优化器状态
步数 + 随机状态 + 数据游标 + 版本

flow.en: Reload all required state at the same update boundary; a weight file alone cannot reproduce the continuation.
flow.zh-hans: 在同一更新边界恢复所需状态；仅有权重文件不能复现原来的继续过程。
